knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic contract portfolio
knowledge.detail: Four fictional agreements provide client, type, value, term, governing law, renewal, status, pages, and risk-score evidence.

knowledge.name: Clause-level agreement evidence
knowledge.detail: Packaged liability, IP, payment, termination, SLA, change-order, indemnity, data, and non-compete findings ground review.

knowledge.name: Internal contract policy baseline
knowledge.detail: Fixed thresholds cover liability caps, payment days, IP protection, mutual indemnity, cure periods, data, changes, and SLA caps.

knowledge.name: Governed knowledge and skill package
knowledge.detail: Two synthetic knowledge files, four operation skills, global instructions, and locked cases preserve the review boundaries.

intelligence_processing.name: Agreement portfolio risk triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks agreements by recorded risk, value, high-risk clauses, and renewal timing to focus authorized counsel attention.

intelligence_processing.name: Clause-level issue analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Explains source-backed clause issues and draft recommendations across liability, IP, payment, and operational terms.

intelligence_processing.name: Internal-policy evidence screening
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares packaged clause evidence with policy and returns REVIEW REQUIRED rather than pass when evidence is absent.

intelligence_processing.name: Negotiation brief preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Separates priority amendments, preferred positions, fallbacks, and escalation points as drafts for authorized counsel review.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Legal operations, attorneys, and executives invoke four bounded review operations through a validated Draft agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat and API
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file RAPP agent runs locally through chat and streaming endpoints using bundled synthetic evidence.

clients_user_interface.name: SharePoint agreement evidence seam
clients_user_interface.detail: Approved production connections may supply governed agreements; the current package has no customer contracts or live binding.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Word counsel workflow
clients_user_interface.detail: Word is the intended counsel-controlled review and redline surface; the agent does not edit, send, or accept contract language.

management_reporting.name: Contract Risk Scan
management_reporting.detail: Reports portfolio value, elevated-risk exposure, ranked agreements, high-risk issue counts, renewals, and review actions.

management_reporting.name: Clause-Level Risk Analysis
management_reporting.detail: Reports sections, clause names, severity, documented issues, and draft recommendations with synthetic-evidence labeling.

management_reporting.name: Compliance Check Results
management_reporting.detail: Reports policy standards, evidence-backed gaps, required actions, and REVIEW REQUIRED states without a legal determination.

management_reporting.name: Renegotiation Brief
management_reporting.detail: Reports non-negotiable and preferred draft positions, fallbacks, value exposure, and General Counsel escalation points.

tools.name: ContractRiskReviewAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Portable Python BasicAgent exposes four deterministic review operations over the fixed synthetic contract snapshot.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the tool and exposes conversational chat, streaming, and health endpoints.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The deployment model routes plain-language requests and presents grounded tool results within the legal-review boundary.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts four skills and two knowledge files in a validated Draft agent; publication requires separate confirmation.

tools.name: SharePoint
tools.detail: Approved production seam for governed agreement evidence; no live customer repository is connected in the package.

tools.name: Microsoft Word
tools.detail: Supports counsel-controlled review and redlining after approval; the agent performs no contract amendment or delivery.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Only the bundled portfolio, clauses, policy, renewal calendar, and skills are authoritative; missing facts are not invented.

supporting_features.name: Explicit four-operation routing
supporting_features.detail: Natural-language intent maps only to risk scan, clause analysis, policy screening, or negotiation brief preparation.

supporting_features.name: Missing-evidence fail-closed control
supporting_features.detail: Agreements without packaged clause evidence receive REVIEW REQUIRED, preventing an unsupported pass or compliance conclusion.

supporting_features.name: Legal review and no-advice boundary
supporting_features.detail: Outputs provide review support only, preserve authorized legal review, and never claim legal or regulatory advice.

supporting_features.name: No contract amendment side effects
supporting_features.detail: The agent does not edit, approve, send, accept, or execute contract language, negotiation positions, or external communications.

supporting_features.name: Locked four-case validation
supporting_features.detail: One persona-language case per operation passed Brainstem isolation and Copilot Studio Preview with required evidence anchors.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication separation
supporting_features.detail: Validated Copilot Studio agents remain unpublished Drafts; connections, legal review, and publishing require authorization.
